beats.vo: Here’s Groundtruth, our Chrome extension for home buyers, running on a realestate.com.au listing. It pulls just the address. Right up top, it shows what this place should actually sell for—around eight hundred thirty-two thousand—compared to the Microburbs value, seven eighty-five.
beats.caption: [[Chrome extension]] on realestate.com.au · what it should sell for vs Microburbs value
beats.action: s1 3–20: page load, panel, price check.
beats.voText_orig: This is Groundtruth, a Chrome extension for home buyers, on a real realestate.com.au listing. It reads only the address. Up top: what it should really sell for, about eight hundred and thirty-two thousand, against a Microburbs value of seven eighty-five.

beats.vo: Click on Verified home and you’ll see the address match receipt: the address we grabbed, the exact G-NAF ID, and four out of four checks.
beats.caption: [[Address match]] receipt · address read · G-NAF id · 4/4 checks
beats.voText_orig: Tap Verified home and the address match receipt opens: the address it read, the G-NAF ID of the exact home, and four of four checks.

beats.vo: From the Microburbs API: seven of this agency's last ten sales sold above their guide, typically by three point nine percent.
beats.caption: [[Microburbs API]]: 7 of 10 of this agency's sales sold above guide
beats.voText_orig: From the Microburbs API: seven of this agency's last ten sales sold above their guide, typically by three point nine percent.

beats.vo: The buyer can enter the guide they were given—say, nine hundred thousand. That’s different from what’s on record, and it’s fifteen percent higher than Microburbs’ estimate.
beats.caption: Your guide ($900k) vs record ($800k) · [[15% above]] Microburbs' estimate
beats.voText_orig: A buyer can type the guide they were quoted. Nine hundred thousand differs from the guide on record, and sits fifteen percent above Microburbs' estimate.

beats.vo: Realestate.com.au updates listings right on the page. Here’s Goulburn Street, priced around one point three million. Switch back to the results, choose Bourke Street, and the receipt refreshes for that property.
beats.caption: In-page listing switch · the receipt [[updates]] to the new home
beats.action: s6 14–39: Goulburn St → back → 902/417-419 Bourke St.
beats.voText_orig: Realestate.com.au swaps listings in place. Here's Goulburn Street, about one point three million. Back to the results, pick Bourke Street, and the receipt updates to the new home.

beats.action: s7 0–11: Domain listing with the panel.
beats.voText_orig: Domain works too: Cooper Street, Surry Hills, an exact address match. Now, the thirty-second briefing.

beats.vo: Listings never tell you what could go up next door. The 3D view shows nearby lots at their legal planning height. In this spot, two lots within a hundred metres could add four or five storeys.
beats.caption: What can [[legally rise next door]] — live on realestate.com.au
beats.action: s3d: real realestate.com.au panel, 902/417-419 Bourke St; slow push-in to the rendered 3D map.
beats.voText_orig: What listings never show: what can legally rise next door. The 3D view raises nearby lots to their planning limits. Here, two lots within a hundred metres could rise four to five more storeys.

beats.vo: When a listing hides the unit number, Groundtruth won't guess. It asks the buyer how many bedrooms, and narrows the building.
beats.caption: Hidden unit: no guessing · tap [[bedrooms]] to narrow
beats.action: Demo page: 417-419 Bourke St, Building state, tap 2.
beats.voText_orig: When a listing hides the unit number, Groundtruth won't guess. It asks the buyer how many bedrooms, and narrows the building.
